surfacing_design_note: acceptable_baseline and acceptable_fold are IDENTICAL per pilot by design, not oversight. router-pilot-contract.md sec 3.2/3.3 pins the LEADING (and only currently-implemented) fold-arm mechanism as per-source virtual surfaces registered under an internal alias (fetch_X__spec, tier=template) which the env-gated pool substitution (registration.py:_relabel_virtual, verified in-tree) RELABELS to the twin's own name with tier=general when TRID3NT_FETCHER_FOLD_ARM is set -- so in BOTH arms the visible registry name a phrasing must hit is the twin name itself; only the underlying callable differs (hand-written fn vs router.route(spec, ...)). The consumption-pair alternate surface (search_data_catalog + fetch_from_catalog, contract sec 3.2 candidate B / open decision #3) is NOT implemented as a fold-arm toggle in the current tree (no code path surfaces pilots through it as an arm) and is therefore excluded from acceptable_fold here; flag to NATE if arm B should be added before sign-off.
